## Source and method

- https://developer.apple.com/documentation/healthkit/metadata-keys

Every HKMetadataKey constant on Apple's Metadata Keys collection (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/healthkit/metadata-keys) and its Workout Metadata Keys sub-collection, read on 2026-10-04 from the JSON Apple serves to render developer.apple.com, one key page each. Names, topic group, abstract, platform versions and deprecation are copied from Apple's payload unchanged. One column is DERIVED: valueType, read from the sentence in Apple's own text that names what the key's value is; that sentence is published beside it in valueTypeEvidence, and both are null where Apple's text does not say. Apple's abstracts are reproduced for identification of the API surface.

## Fields

| Field | Description | JSON types | Null in |
|---|---|---|---|
| `swiftName` | The Swift constant name | string | 0 of 67 rows |
| `objcName` | The Objective-C constant name; null where Apple gives none | string | 0 of 67 rows |
| `group` | Apple's topic group on the Metadata Keys page | string | 0 of 67 rows |
| `subgroup` | The section inside the Workout Metadata Keys sub-collection; null elsewhere | null, string | 45 of 67 rows |
| `valueType` | DERIVED: the value type valueTypeEvidence names; null where Apple does not state it | null, string | 18 of 67 rows |
| `valueTypeEvidence` | Apple's sentence valueType was read from, verbatim | null, string | 18 of 67 rows |
| `iosIntroduced` | iOS version the key was introduced in, per Apple's availability data | string | 0 of 67 rows |
| `watchosIntroduced` | watchOS version the key was introduced in, per Apple's availability data | string | 0 of 67 rows |
| `deprecated` | yes when Apple's payload marks the key deprecated | string | 0 of 67 rows |
| `abstract` | Apple's abstract, verbatim; null where Apple publishes none | null, string | 13 of 67 rows |
| `appleDocs` | Apple's documentation page for the key | string | 0 of 67 rows |
| `page` | This site's row for the key | string | 0 of 67 rows |

A null means the source does not state the value or it could not be verified. It never means zero, and it is never a guess. In the CSV a null is an empty unquoted field.

## Update cadence

- `src/data/healthkitMetadataKeys.ts` is generated by `scripts/fetch-healthkit-metadata-keys.mjs` from the sources above, last read 2026-10-04.
- No workflow runs that script: it is run by hand when the sources are re-read.
- The files are rebuilt by `npm run datasets` (scripts/build-datasets.mjs); a run with no source change writes byte-identical files. The edition stays 2026.1, and a new edition ships under a new file name rather than overwriting this one.
